data.body: Upstream-cause status: commit 729d2c2 lands the `review.minor_findings_create_tickets` gate (default: false; opt-in via dso-config.conf). REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md post-pass inspection now consults the gate before auto-filing minor / suggestion findings as bug tickets. The gate prevents NEW tickets of this shape from being auto-created, but does NOT close this ticket — the underlying condition described above persists in the codebase. Close manually if no longer worth tracking.
